# slv_visual

> Ukraine-based web development and product design studio led by Yaroslav. Builds fast, high-quality websites, online stores and brand experiences in English and Ukrainian. Custom projects start from $1,000.

slv_visual (brand mark "SV") is a one-person studio combining web development and product design. The focus is quality, speed and automation for business. Working languages are English and Ukrainian.

## Services
- Website development — landing pages, corporate sites, web apps
- E-commerce and online stores
- Product and UI/UX design
- Brand identity and creative development
- Automation for business

## Selected work
- [Master the Blade](https://ronin-forge.store): one-page store selling custom-made katanas on order.
- [МЕЛМАН](https://melman.shop/): merch store for the #1 ostrich in Ukrainian TikTok.
- MOCLAME HOME: e-commerce for 3D-printed home decor with live 3D previews (in development).

## Pricing
- Custom projects start from $1,000. Final scope and price are agreed after a briefing.
